direction of motion of the particle at the instant 4 s after projection. [5]

A particle P of mass 0.3 kg is attached to one end of a light elastic string of natural length 0.6 m and
modulus of elasticity 24 N. The other end of the string is attached to a fixed point O. The particle P
is released from rest at the point 0.4 m vertically below O.
A particle P is projected horizontally from a point O on a rough horizontal surface. The coefficient of
friction between the particle and the surface is 0.2. A horizontal force of magnitude 0.06t N directed
away from O acts on P, where t s is the time after projection. P comes to rest when t = 4.
